tips.label: Money tips
tips.title: Paying, calmly

card.title: Tap almost everywhere
card.text: Cards and phone wallets are accepted nearly everywhere, from cafés to city transit.

cash.title: Cash is rarely needed
cash.text: Carry a little for markets and remote areas. Some cafés now refuse cash entirely.

tipping.title: Tipping isn't expected
tipping.text: Staff earn a full wage. Rounding up for great service is welcome, never required.

fees.title: Check foreign fees
fees.text: Many cards add 2–3% per purchase. When asked, always pay in the local currency.

atm.title: Use ATMs inside banks
atm.text: Bank-branch ATMs are safer and usually cheaper than standalone machines.

gst.title: GST refund, Australia only
gst.text: Spend A$300+ with one shop within 60 days of departure, then claim via the TRS at the airport.

tips.notice: Rates shown are indicative mid-market rates for planning only and are not an offer to exchange currency. They are not suitable for financial transactions. Prices are typical examples and vary by city and season.
